decision: Operator permissions are separate from membership, host, customer, payer and tenant relations. Consent-based export is an independent exact recipient/audience/fact/media grant. Current authority and synchronous use share one owner fence.
prior_candidate_status: Preserved unsubmitted source author policy and finite fixture; not independently approved or integrated.

permission_families.authority: Existing current campaign membership/binding owner; no operator permission is inferred.
permission_families.restrictions: Approved controls/status only; no support, forced dice, private audience or export implication.

permission_families.authority: Independent operator authentication, MFA, verified reason/ticket, exact active scope/action/version and time.
permission_families.restrictions: Redacted state, receipt IDs and diagnostic aggregates; no host/private audience grant. Projection remains the owning API responsibility.

permission_families.authority: Three distinct operator permission variants; exact current source scope.
permission_families.restrictions: Existing telemetry owner exposes bounded read-only queries and retention operations; no agent SQL mutation/deletion. Telemetry export grants no game/media export.

permission_families.family: Debug mutation, refund, deletion, restore and rights unlock
permission_families.authority: Five distinct explicit operator permission variants, never support inspection.
permission_families.restrictions: Debug additionally requires deployment enablement. Typed reviewed commands, strict preconditions and durable session/commerce commit remain the respective owners; no arbitrary event/code/wallet injection.

permission_families.authority: Separate explicit variants, approved exceptional audit and private rights, independent of support/host/capture permission.
permission_families.restrictions: Break glass grant duration at most 900 seconds and current within its issue/expiry interval. No rights bypass or arbitrary game/wallet mutation.

permission_families.authority: Current enabled explicit exact principal, recipient, audience, tenant/campaign/session, export identity and selected fact/media item. Consent, capture/contributor rights, source rights/attribution/license and exact source/access/rights versions must all hold.
permission_families.restrictions: Credential/binding/grant/consent/rights rechecked inside serialized owner callback before every synchronous disclosure and after asynchronous preparation. Expiry/revocation/absence/mismatch/unavailable authority emits no new bytes. Already delivered bytes cannot be recalled. Sharing/community/marketplace endpoints are not enabled by this policy.

alternatives_rejected: Derive support from host, payer or tenant ownership: collapses independent authorities.
One broad operator permission: read-only support cannot authorize private capture or mutations.
Treat private viewing/capture/cache/hash as export permission: omits recipient, selection, rights and current versions.
Check once before asynchronous work: permits disclosure after revocation.
Return a checked cached capability then unlock before use: leaves a check/use race.
bounded_runtime_verification: Native integration fixtures exercise actual synchronous handler/byte receivers, all eleven positive operator permissions, every cross-action refusal, host/payer/customer role negatives, trusted MFA/ticket/current-access refusals, debug enablement, private audit/rights, the exact break-glass boundary, positive facts/media, complete export scope/rights/version refusal families, and revocation after preparation/between chunks.
safe_observation_contract: Pure typed result facts only; the module starts no exporter, logs no principal/credentials/private payload and uses no trace identity as permission. Caller uses df-observe to record classified safe operation/grant-version outcomes.
unresolved_external_qualification: Real credential/operator issuers, MFA/reason verification and durable audit authority adapters.
Reviewed legal source/contributor/attribution/license rights evidence, consent issuance and actual export selection adapters.
PostgreSQL/RLS transaction implementations of the current-authority serialization port and production revocation propagation bounds.
Generated RPC/admin/customer listener mounting, private audience projection and real asynchronous bounded export byte transport.
Restore replay of durable deletion/revocation tombstones before serving. This pure policy neither deletes nor restores data.
qualification: Rust policy/source boundary and deterministic native/WASM checks; no production credential, rights, UI, provider, database or whole-game acceptance is claimed. Independent evaluation and integrated source acceptance remain required.
